mentions.name: Joy
mentions.description: Joy is a CLI for product management that keeps the backlog as plain text in a git repo, so tasks can be added with commands like `joy add "fix the login bug"`. AI agents work through the same workflow as humans, with identities, capabilities, and cost budgets, and every action is recorded in the git log.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Joy, a CLI for product management. Your backlog is plain text in your git repo. joy add "fix the login bug", done.
AI works through the same workflow as humans: identities, capabilities, cost budgets, every action in the git log.
